#effect sizes
```{r data prep, echo=FALSE}
dfSummary<-DS_final %>% group_by(Dataset_ID, Treatment) %>% summarize(MEAN=mean(gC_CO2), SDEV=sd(gC_CO2), SS=n())

dfSummaryCTL <- dfSummary  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="CTL")
dfSummaryOTC <- dfSummary  %>% dplyr::filter(Treatment=="OTC")
dfSummary <- full_join(dfSummaryCTL, dfSummaryOTC, by="Dataset_ID")

dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("MEAN_CTL"="MEAN.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("MEAN_OTC"="MEAN.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("SDEV_CTL"="SDEV.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("SDEV_OTC"="SDEV.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("SS_CTL"="SS.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("SS_OTC"="SS.y")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

```

##Hedges SMD
```{r Hedges SMD, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}

SMD <-
  escalc("SMD", m1i = MEAN_OTC,
    n1i = SS_OTC,
    sd1i = SDEV_OTC,
    m2i = MEAN_CTL,
    n2i = SS_CTL,
    sd2i = SDEV_CTL,
    data = dfSummary 
  )

SMD<-dplyr::rename(SMD,any_of(c("Hedges_SMD"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
SMD<-dplyr::rename(SMD,any_of(c("Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

Mean_SMD<-mean(SMD$Hedges_SMD)
# Mean_SMD

```

##raw mean diff
```{r raw mean diff, echo=FALSE}
############# Raw MD ############# 
MD <-
  escalc("MD", m1i = MEAN_OTC,
    n1i = SS_OTC,
    sd1i = SDEV_OTC,
    m2i = MEAN_CTL,
    n2i = SS_CTL,
    sd2i = SDEV_CTL,
    data = dfSummary 
  )

MD<-dplyr::rename(MD,any_of(c("raw_MD"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
MD<-dplyr::rename(MD,any_of(c("raw_MD_VARIANCE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

Mean_MD<-mean(MD$raw_MD)
# Mean_MD


```

##ratio of means 
```{r ROM, echo=FALSE}
############# Log Response Ratio ROM ############# 

ROM <-
  escalc("ROM", m1i = MEAN_OTC,
    n1i = SS_OTC,
    sd1i = SDEV_OTC,
    m2i = MEAN_CTL,
    n2i = SS_CTL,
    sd2i = SDEV_CTL,
    data = dfSummary 
  )

ROM<-dplyr::rename(ROM,any_of(c("ROM"="yi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
ROM<-dplyr::rename(ROM,any_of(c("ROM_VARIANCE"="vi")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed

Mean_RR<-mean(ROM$ROM)
# Mean_RR
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
dfSummary<-full_join(SMD, MD, by=c("Dataset_ID", "Treatment.x", "Treatment.y"))
dfSummary<-full_join(dfSummary, ROM, by=c("Dataset_ID", "Treatment.x", "Treatment.y"))

dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("MEAN_CTL"="MEAN_CTL.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("MEAN_OTC"="MEAN_OTC.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("SDEV_CTL"="SDEV_CTL.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("SDEV_OTC"="SDEV_OTC.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("SS_CTL"="SS_CTL.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dplyr::rename(dfSummary,any_of(c("SS_OTC"="SS_OTC.x")))  # CHANGES: plyr::rename -> dplyr::rename (new = old); plyr removed
dfSummary<-dfSummary[,-c(12:17, 20:25)]

SMD$CI_lb<-SMD$Hedges_SMD-1.96*sqrt(SMD$Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE)
SMD$CI_ub<-SMD$Hedges_SMD+1.96*sqrt(SMD$Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE)

MD$CI_lb<-MD$raw_MD-1.96*sqrt(MD$raw_MD_VARIANCE)
MD$CI_ub<-MD$raw_MD+1.96*sqrt(MD$raw_MD_VARIANCE)

ROM$CI_lb<-ROM$ROM-1.96*sqrt(ROM$ROM_VARIANCE)
ROM$CI_ub<-ROM$ROM+1.96*sqrt(ROM$ROM_VARIANCE)

dfSummary$Hedges_SMD_CI_lb<-SMD$Hedges_SMD-1.96*sqrt(SMD$Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE)
dfSummary$Hedges_SMD_CI_ub<-SMD$Hedges_SMD+1.96*sqrt(SMD$Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE)

dfSummary$raw_MD_CI_lb<-MD$raw_MD-1.96*sqrt(MD$raw_MD_VARIANCE)
dfSummary$raw_MD_CI_ub<-MD$raw_MD+1.96*sqrt(MD$raw_MD_VARIANCE)

dfSummary$ROM_CI_lb<-ROM$ROM-1.96*sqrt(ROM$ROM_VARIANCE)
dfSummary$ROM_CI_ub<-ROM$ROM+1.96*sqrt(ROM$ROM_VARIANCE)

dfSummary<-dfSummary %>% relocate(Hedges_SMD_CI_lb, .after = Hedges_SMD_VARIANCE)
dfSummary<-dfSummary %>% relocate(Hedges_SMD_CI_ub, .after = Hedges_SMD_CI_lb)
dfSummary<-dfSummary %>% relocate(raw_MD_CI_lb, .after = raw_MD_VARIANCE)
dfSummary<-dfSummary %>% relocate(raw_MD_CI_ub, .after = raw_MD_CI_lb)
dfSummary<-dfSummary %>% relocate(ROM_CI_lb, .after = ROM_VARIANCE)
dfSummary<-dfSummary %>% relocate(ROM_CI_ub, .after = ROM_CI_lb)

write.csv(dfSummary, "dfSummary.csv")
```
